contract_checks.descriptor_reference_check: format=reference verifies actual custody/existence; absent namespace does not by itself enforce record type
contract_checks.downstream_semantics: validate_returned_values reprojects saved selected sheet and exact cell/binding equality; read validates native witness/selection associations and generated reference/context/term identities without source reread

adaptations: Real marginal credit responses pass into the fit without integer coercion
Completed Episode acquisitions condition on observation; no failure/usability model
A fresh original fitter cold-fits the entire score history each turn
Original numeric bands and delta/Laplace curvature approximation are retained
Signed corrections use paired gain/loss marks at the same action ranks inside the estimator
After an observed loss, component alpha/2 bands subtract to an approximate signed net interval
limitations: The fractional kernel is not a continuous-response probability density
Uncertainty assumes the working model and is not coverage calibrated
Credit units affect effective information and must remain fixed within an Episode
Rank-decay extrapolation assumes declining yield; late discoveries can violate it
No failed-attempt probability is estimated from completed-only acquisitions
The inherited local optimizer has no global optimum or convergence certificate; bands can jump across history lengths
Before any observed loss the original nonnegative model assumes zero loss; this is an explicit working-model assumption
Gain/loss interval subtraction is not coverage calibrated; Bonferroni allocation cannot calibrate the underlying Laplace approximation

per_episode_units.direct_tool: One completed selected acquisition supplies one local observation
per_episode_units.failed_or_unexecuted_request: Public invalid requests and failed or unexecuted tool attempts create no acquisition or estimator observation
per_episode_units.read_or_comparison: A completed acquisition can have zero marginal credit
per_episode_units.reasoning: One completed scientific interpretation action supplies one local observation, including when it uses existing evidence
per_episode_units.root: One root-selected completed reasoning action, tool or child investigation supplies one root action; nested child operations add no ancestor observations
per_episode_units.shared_refresh: Shared credit refreshes do not add action observations
